pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.a: frame value shown, same for the three judges
keys.z_plus|z_minus|z_plus2: log-odds towards class 1 = logit of class 1 minus logit of class 0
keys.val_*: the same on validation; val_image is an index in the CIFAR-10 training set

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames

split.validation: 500 training images per class, drawn once per task with numpy default_rng(crc32('20261110/<task>')); the other 9,000 train
split.test: all 2,000 CIFAR-10 test images of the two classes

judges.plus: training frame a ~ N(+mu, 1) on class 1, N(-mu, 1) on class 0
judges.minus: training frame a ~ N(-mu, 1) on class 1, N(+mu, 1) on class 0

manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.test_and_validation_frames: a = sqrt(1 + mu^2) * eps, eps ~ N(0, 1) from numpy default_rng(crc32('bench/<task>/s<seed>/<test|val>-a')): the same eps for every mu
manifest.torch_seeds: crc32('bench/<task>/s<seed>/<role>') & 0x7fffffff, the same for every mu; it seeds the initialisation and one CUDA generator for batch order, crops, flips and training frames

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip
hyperparameters.evaluation: eval mode, fp32 with TF32 convolutions, no augmentation

deviations: Two seeds (0 and 1) instead of three (protocol section 10). The pilot rule chose 30 epochs; one network then takes about 12.5 s on the L4 (21,500 images/s in a single process, concurrent processes are slower), so E1 with three seeds was estimated at about 70 minutes, over the 60-minute cap. Section 10 prescribes dropping to two seeds first; with two seeds the estimate is about 47 minutes.

settings.bootstrap_weight: chosen again in each resample on 13 weights

H1a.rule: median Spearman(mu, rho) <= -0.9 and, at the two highest mu, the phi interval above 90 degrees in every seed, in at least 4 tasks of 5

H1b.rule: lower end of the tuned turing's interval above sqrt(1 + k^2) in >= 80% of the pairs whose phi interval is above 90 degrees

H1c.rule: median tuned/Tu_app in [0.9, 1.1] and mean |pred - tuned|/tuned smaller for Tu_app than for sqrt(1 + k^2)

H1d.rule: median ln(measured width)/ln(predicted width) in [0.7, 1.3] and Spearman(phi, measured width) <= -0.7

H1e.rule: median Spearman(mu, rho) >= 0.9 in the equal pairs (threshold of H1a and H2a; the protocol says only that rho rises) and median tuned turing <= 1.1 at the highest mu

H1f.rule: at every mu, median over tasks and seeds of d_pair_tuned(opposite) / d_pair_tuned at mu = 0 (task mean over seeds) <= 1.05
